body:
Many thanks for creating ART, I have edited many images with it, and really enjoy using it :-)  

Unfortunately, when editing images yesterday, I found ART crashed repeatedly.  

What caused this, is when I open the RAW file and .arp profile uploaded here

https://drive.proton.me/urls/EDB0KYK6NC#nGVKBOuT3qGL

Then once they are loaded, I enable Spot Removal, then zoom in to 100% – the program gets 10% through rendering the noise reduction then freezes (as per uploaded screenshot) – then crashes after approx 20sec and disappears.  

I am using ART 1.26.7 on Linux Mint 22.1, downloaded from the ART-1.26.7-linux64.tar.xz link.  I have tried restarting my computer, reverting from 1.26.7 to 1.26.5, and even downloading the AppImage, but in all cases the program still crashes in the same manner.  

However, if I enable Spot Removal, turn off Noise Reduction, and then zoom in to 100% – the program works fine and does not crash.  

My computer has 64GB RAM (but no swapfile/swap partition), so I would be surprised if ART ran out of memory.  However the system monitor only shows ART using 1.6 GB of RAM when it hangs before crashing.  

I have used the spot removal tool before without this problem, even with 15+ spots.  The only thing that might be different this time, is that instead of using Capture Sharpening and masked Smoothing, I am using masked Texture Boost instead of Capture Sharpening.  

Please would you mind having a look at this, to see if there is a way to resolve this problem?  

And if there is any further information I can supply that would be helpful, please let me know.
title: [BUG] ART freezes and crashes when enabling spot removal then zooming in to 100%
